reference_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN net_revenue_eur IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
            WHEN net_revenue_eur < 50 THEN 'small'
            WHEN net_revenue_eur < 100 THEN 'medium'
            ELSE 'large'
       END AS size_band,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines
FROM sales
GROUP BY size_band
